meta.name: accredible-certificates-automation
meta.description: Automate Accredible Certificates tasks via Rube MCP (Composio). Always search tools first for current schemas.

copy.tagline: 自动管理 Accredible 证书的创建和发放
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要批量颁发或更新 Accredible 证书。
copy.tagline_en: Automate Accredible certificate creation and delivery.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently issue or update Accredible certificates.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会通过 Rube MCP 自动管理 Accredible 证书：先搜索可用工具，再检查连接是否正常，最后按用户指令执行创建、查询等操作。
howto.when: 当你提到与 Accredible 证书相关的任务（如查看、创建、更新证书）时触发。Claude 会先调用 RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS 获取当前工具模式。

say.text: 帮我查一下我的 Accredible 证书列表。
say.note: Claude 将搜索工具并查询证书列表。

say.text: 创建一个新证书，颁发给张三。
say.note: Claude 将搜索创建证书的工具并执行。

say.text: 更新证书 ID 为 123 的有效期。
say.note: Claude 将搜索更新工具并执行。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will manage Accredible Certificates via Rube MCP: first search for available tools, then check the connection status, and finally execute create, query, or update operations as instructed.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention tasks related to Accredible Certificates, such as listing, creating, or updating certificates. Claude will first call RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS to get current schemas.

say_en.note: Claude will search tools and retrieve the certificate list.

say_en.text: Create a new certificate for Zhang San.
say_en.note: Claude will search for the create tool and execute it.

say_en.text: Update the expiry date of certificate ID 123.
say_en.note: Claude will search for the update tool and execute it.
